items.exampleEn: She wants to become a doctor.
Turn off the lights when you leave the room.
Put your bag on the chair.
Can you help me with this box?
items.exampleZh: 你可以幫我搬這個箱子嗎？

items.exampleEn: We talk on the phone every night.

items.sentenceEn: Let me put it on the table.

items.audioEn: The movie begins at seven, so we leave home at six.
items.audioZh: 電影七點開始，所以我們六點出門。

items.sentenceEn: We leave for school at seven.
I want to become a teacher.

items.stemEn: Can I ____ to you for a minute?
items.stemZh: 我可以跟你說一下話嗎？

items.passageEn: My brother wants to become a cook. Every weekend, he helps our mother in the kitchen. She lets him make dinner, and they talk about food. He keeps a notebook of his favorite dishes. He says, "One day, I will have my own restaurant."
items.passageZh: 我哥哥想當廚師。每個週末他都在廚房幫媽媽。媽媽讓他煮晚餐，他們會聊食物。他有一本筆記本，記著他最喜歡的菜。他說：「總有一天我會有自己的餐廳。」

questions.questionZh: 哥哥的筆記本裡寫了什麼？

referenceEn: I help my mother wash the dishes every day.
Every day, I help my mom wash the dishes.
rubricZh: help 後面接人再接動詞原形（例如 help my mother wash the dishes）；help … with 也正確
習慣性的事用現在簡單式；「媽媽」可寫，例如 mother、mom 等

referenceEn: The summer vacation begins this Friday.
rubricZh: 動詞配合主詞（例如 begins）；寫 starts 也正確
「這個星期五」可寫，例如 this Friday、on Friday 等
「暑假」可寫，例如 summer vacation、the summer holidays 等
